# Bitview

> Bitview is a free, open-source Bitcoin data server: on-chain metrics, blocks, mempool and mining data, with charts and an API, at bitview.space or beside your own Bitcoin Core node. 22031 on-chain time-series and 107 API operations.

## API

- Version: `v0.13.0`
- Base URL: https://bitview.space
- Authentication: None
- Browser access: Permissive CORS
- [Full plain-text reference](https://bitview.space/llms-full.txt)
- [Compact API summary](https://bitview.space/api.json)
- [Full OpenAPI](https://bitview.space/openapi.json)
- [Series catalog](https://bitview.space/api/series)
- [Interactive documentation](https://bitview.space/api)

Build tools from the full OpenAPI document; the compact summary is a smaller custom (non-OpenAPI) overview. Use `llms-full.txt` only when a complete readable reference is needed.

## Series workflow

Never invent a series identifier.

1. Search by meaning: `GET /api/series/search?q=<plain-language concept>`.
2. Inspect a returned identifier: `GET /api/series/<series>` returns its description, supported indexes, value type, unit (what the value type measures), and the indexes whose values can be null (missing or undefined).
3. Fetch data: `GET /api/series/<series>/<index>?start=<inclusive>&end=<exclusive>`.
4. Fetch one current value with `GET /api/series/<series>/<index>/latest`. For several series, use `GET /api/series/bulk?series=<comma-separated names>&index=<index>`.

## MCP

- Endpoint: https://mcp.bitview.space/
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: None
- Protocol: MCP 2025-06-18 to 2026-07-28
- [Setup](https://mcp.bitview.space/)

Add it to an assistant with that one URL:

- Claude: Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector, paste the URL, choose No sign-in.
- ChatGPT: chatgpt.com/plugins > plus button > Add custom MCP server, paste the URL, choose no authentication.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http bitview https://mcp.bitview.space/`
- Codex: `codex mcp add bitview --url https://mcp.bitview.space/`
- Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --scope user --transport http bitview https://mcp.bitview.space/`
- Qwen Code: `qwen mcp add --transport http bitview https://mcp.bitview.space/`

Tested with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor's CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and Qwen Code. Claude on the web, ChatGPT and other clients on MCP 2025-06-18 or newer should work but haven't been tested. Problems: support@bitview.space.

The MCP server is stateless and read-only. Its tools are generated from these OpenAPI operations.
